description: This file defines the LinearBestFit class in the PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Shared\Trend namespace, which provides methods for performing linear regression analysis, calculating best-fit lines, and producing related equations based on input data.

classes.name: LinearBestFit
classes.description: A class implementing linear regression to determine the best fit line, capable of calculating Y given X, X given Y, and producing the equation of the line.

methods.name: getValueOfYForX
methods.description: Calculates and returns the Y value corresponding to a given X based on the regression line.

methods.name: getValueOfXForY
methods.description: Calculates and returns the X value corresponding to a given Y based on the regression line.

methods.name: getEquation
methods.description: Returns a string representing the equation of the best-fit line.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs the LinearBestFit object and performs regression analysis with provided data.
